headline: Fronts Stir Along Nevish and Weathered Lines
war_summary: The latest ledger records a livelier and more unsettled picture than the previous edition. Weathered Expanse has risen to 52 base events in 24 hours, including nine in the last two, while Nevish Line has climbed to 35 daily events and eight recent. Kuura Strand remains a chief danger, with 32 events and two in the latest two-hour window; Faden Point still dominates its record. Marban Hollow also holds 32 daily events, six of them recent, with Checkpoint Bua accounting for most of the movement. Linn Mercy has produced three fresh events amid ten for the day, led by Lathair and Outwich Ranch. Godcrofts has likewise seen two events in the latest two hours, both at Argosa, though its broader activity remains light. Stlican Shelf’s earlier bustle has gone quiet, while Farranac Coast’s recorded capture is now old news. Several rear sectors show little or no movement. Casualty rates are cooling on many contested fronts, but Mooring County has sharply accelerated without a recorded base event. No victor is declared.
